algorithm: Damage is k plus the sum of min(k, adjacent attack gap); binary search its first feasible k.
correctness_argument: Each attack contributes until the next attack or poison expiry; the last contributes k. The sum is monotone, and k=h is feasible, so lower-bound search returns the minimum.
problem_understanding: Poison refresh replaces the previous effect.
